ACCEPT · seat 2 · 2026-10-26T17:14Z · PR #26253 head `c0333981` (#25933 PR 2, the board)

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| scope | 6 files, +345/−7: `plugin-kanban` (`KanbanImpl.tsx`, `KanbanBoardCore.tsx`, `ObjectKanban.tsx`, new pin file), its sources record, a root `.changeset/` |
| contract | `canDropCard(from, to)` is an optional PROP, absent → every lane open as before; `KanbanRenderer` passes none, so a host-mounted board is unchanged |
| refusal | `handleDragEnd` refuses a closed cross-lane drop before the optimistic move and before `onCardMove`; same-column drop is never asked; `onDragCancel` clears the dimming |
| derivation | `ObjectKanban` reads `stateMachineNextValues(objectDef, groupBy, from)` from `@object-ui/core` (the form's and grid editor's read); `null` (undeclared from-state) and the Uncategorized lane stay open |
| visuals | blocked lanes: `aria-disabled`, `data-kanban-drop-blocked`, `opacity-40`, no `isOver` ring, on flat and swimlane layouts; no new visible text |
| governance | `check-governed-merges`: NOT governed, 352 lines ≤ 3000 |
| landing | `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` clean; no commit on main touches `plugin-kanban` or its sources record since base `df8aac41`; no other open PR in the plugin-kanban line |

Ablation evidence from the report (gate unset → 3 red; guard forced false → exactly the refusal red) is accepted as stated. Main's Test UI 48≠47 red was #26218, repaired by #26231 at 2026-10-26T17:10Z. Seat's route: ready + auto-merge.
